label: Employment and industrial accident insurance: deadline to report the end of coverage
unit: days from the date coverage ends
appliesTo: Employers whose insurance relationship ends because the business closed or operations ceased
why: Recorded apart from the health insurance deadline even though both are 14 days, because the two clocks start from different events. Health insurance runs from the withdrawal event; this one runs from the date the insurance relationship itself is extinguished, which is determined by when the business actually ceased rather than by the date on the closure filing.

history.display: 14 days from the date coverage ends
history.source: Act on the Collection of Premiums for Employment Insurance and Industrial Accident Compensation Insurance
history.note: Employment insurance and industrial accident insurance are collected together and their coverage ends together on closure. Filing does not close the account: the final premium is reconciled against wages actually paid, so a further assessment or a refund can arrive after the report is accepted.
